Class HistoricalCulturalTensorRasterizer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.HistoricalCulturalTensorRasterizer
public final class HistoricalCulturalTensorRasterizer extends Object
High-precision Sociocultural, Linguistic, Religious, and Institutional Cartographic Tensor Rasterizer Facade.

Extracted from HistoricalMapGenerator and modularized to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Compiles empirical archaeological, ethnographic, and historical sociopolitical tensors into 2D raster maps: sovereignty, isogloss, kinship systems, sacred sites/rituals, technological progress, trade networks, institutional hierarchy, ecological footprints, and epidemiological immunity landscapes.

Delegates cartographic operations to specialized engines:

  • HistoricalPolityAndSovereigntyRasterizer for sovereign and political boundaries.
  • HistoricalLinguisticAndKinshipRasterizer for linguistic phyla and anthropological kinship.
  • HistoricalReligiousAndSocietalRasterizer for sacred traditions, technology, trade, and institutions.

1.0.0-beta.2
